text.tspan: FRAME — Verso. Curt performs the final manuscript build. Page 118 is still concealed
ACTION — Source packets, corrections, and uncertainty labels compile beside the
reading edition. A cover proof reads THE TWO ANTHILL PROBLEM. Beside it, a
discarded connected-hills sketch remains visible under a heavy cancellation stroke;
the kept sketch has two separate surfaces and unmarked space between. A revision
slip reads 9 SEPTEMBER 2026 — TITLE REVISION. Neither sketch has a queen,
chamber, or individual agent identity. A small print of the supplied Apache Ant logo
hangs on the back wall, a reconstructed software-history prop. Reserve this print as
blank space in model-generated base art and composite the supplied image afterward.
Two tiny authored ants sit in the desk’s light; they do not stand for particular runs.
DIALOGUE — CURT — “Two incidents. How many went unseen?”
SCREEN / SYSTEM TEXT — CHATGPT — “The picture cannot answer that.”
